title: Proctor Fellow in Values Engagement (FiVE)
bio: Welcome to Harvard! My name is Cat, and I am a first-year PhD student in Organizational Behavior, a program jointly offered between Harvard Business School and Harvard’s Psychology Department. I study the power of relationships in resolving inter/intra-group conflict and in promoting organizational and societal health. Originally from Bel Air, Maryland, I graduated from Cornell University in 2021 where I studied Labor Relations and served as student body president, and received my Master’s in Education from Harvard Graduate School of Education in 2022. When I’m not nose-deep in research articles at my office, I can usually be found in the Yard attempting to befriend Remy (the Harvard Cat) or chatting with friends + students in Annenberg over coffee. I love teaching and working with students and am looking forward to a great year together! Community Yards Elm Yard Area Specialty Proctors Programming Staff Proctors Role Proctors Specialty Proctors
